headline: Japan's GDP Unexpectedly Contracts 0.1% Annualised in Q3
summary: Japan's economy shrank by an annualised 0.1% in the July-September quarter, marking its first contraction in four quarters as persistent inflation and elevated living costs weighed on private consumption.
why: Japan is the world's fourth-largest economy; contraction complicates the Bank of Japan's path toward interest rate normalisation.
